paras.zh: 上汉字课的时候，老师一边说一边在黑板上写了一个“宀”，告诉大家：“‘宀’在汉字中是‘房屋’的意思。”然后，她又在下面写了个“女”字，问大家：“屋子里有个女人，会怎么样？”
paras.py: Shàng Hànzì kè de shíhou, lǎoshī yìbiān shuō yìbiān zài hēibǎn shang xiěle yí gè “mián”, gàosu dàjiā: “‘Mián’ zài Hànzì zhōng shì ‘fángwū’ de yìsi.” Ránhòu, tā yòu zài xiàmiàn xiěle gè “nǚ” zì, wèn dàjiā: “Wūzi li yǒu gè nǚrén, huì zěnmeyàng?”
paras.en: In a Chinese character class, the teacher wrote "宀" on the blackboard as she talked, and told everyone, "In Chinese characters, '宀' means 'house'." Then she wrote the character "女" (woman) under it and asked, "If there is a woman in the house, what will happen?"

paras.zh: 一个学生回答：“麻烦！”
paras.py: Yí gè xuésheng huídá: “Máfan!”
paras.en: One student answered, "Trouble!"

paras.zh: 大家都笑了。
paras.py: Dàjiā dōu xiào le.
paras.en: Everyone laughed.

paras.zh: 老师微笑着说：“如果房子里有个女人，就会平安。所以汉字的‘安’字就是‘宀’下边加一个‘女’字。”
paras.py: Lǎoshī wēixiàozhe shuō: “Rúguǒ fángzi li yǒu gè nǚrén, jiù huì píng'ān. Suǒyǐ Hànzì de ‘ān’ zì jiù shì ‘mián’ xiàbian jiā yí gè ‘nǚ’ zì.”
paras.en: The teacher smiled and said, "If there is a woman in the house, there will be peace (平安 píng'ān). That's why the character '安' (ān, peace) is '宀' with '女' added underneath."

paras.name: 儿子
paras.zh: 爸爸，我有一个问题。
paras.py: Bàba, wǒ yǒu yí gè wèntí.
paras.en: Dad, I have a question.

paras.name: 父亲
paras.zh: 什么问题？
paras.py: Shénme wèntí?
paras.en: What question?

paras.name: 儿子
paras.zh: 你有几个名字？
paras.py: Nǐ yǒu jǐ gè míngzi?
paras.en: How many names do you have?

paras.name: 父亲
paras.zh: 我只有一个名字呀！
paras.py: Wǒ zhǐ yǒu yí gè míngzi ya!
paras.en: I only have one name!

paras.name: 儿子
paras.zh: 不要骗我！你不是还有一个名字，叫“淘气”吗？
paras.py: Bú yào piàn wǒ! Nǐ bú shì hái yǒu yí gè míngzi, jiào “Táoqì” ma?
paras.en: Don't lie to me! Don't you have another name, "Taoqi"?

paras.name: 父亲
paras.zh: 淘气？谁说的？
paras.py: Táoqì? Shéi shuō de?
paras.en: Taoqi? Who said that?

paras.name: 儿子
paras.zh: 今天上课的时候，老师在同学面前说我是“淘气”的孩子。
paras.py: Jīntiān shàngkè de shíhou, lǎoshī zài tóngxué miànqián shuō wǒ shì “táoqì” de háizi.
paras.en: Today in class, the teacher said in front of everyone that I'm "taoqi de haizi". (淘气的孩子 means "a naughty child", but the boy thinks it means "Taoqi's child".)

paras.zh: 一位汽车司机把车停在路边，想睡一会儿。他刚躺下，就有人问时间，他看看表说：“快到十二点了。”他刚睡，又有人敲窗户：“先生，您知道时间吗？”他只好再次看表，回答说：“十二点半了。”
paras.py: Yí wèi qìchē sījī bǎ chē tíng zài lùbiān, xiǎng shuì yíhuìr. Tā gāng tǎngxià, jiù yǒu rén wèn shíjiān, tā kànkan biǎo shuō: “Kuài dào shí'èr diǎn le.” Tā gāng shuì, yòu yǒu rén qiāo chuānghu: “Xiānsheng, nín zhīdào shíjiān ma?” Tā zhǐhǎo zàicì kàn biǎo, huídá shuō: “Shí'èr diǎn bàn le.”
paras.en: A driver parked his car by the road and wanted to sleep for a while. He had just lain down when someone asked him the time. He looked at his watch and said, "It's almost twelve." He had just fallen asleep when someone else knocked on the window: "Sir, do you know what time it is?" He had to look at his watch again and answered, "It's half past twelve."

paras.zh: 但敲窗户的人太多，他根本不能睡觉，于是写了个纸条贴在车窗上：“我不知道时间！我很困！”司机再次躺下。但几分钟后，又有一个人敲窗户：“喂，先生，现在是下午一点差一刻。”
paras.py: Dàn qiāo chuānghu de rén tài duō, tā gēnběn bù néng shuìjiào, yúshì xiěle gè zhǐtiáo tiē zài chēchuāng shang: “Wǒ bù zhīdào shíjiān! Wǒ hěn kùn!” Sījī zàicì tǎngxià. Dàn jǐ fēnzhōng hòu, yòu yǒu yí gè rén qiāo chuānghu: “Wèi, xiānsheng, xiànzài shì xiàwǔ yì diǎn chà yí kè.”
paras.en: But so many people knocked on the window that he couldn't sleep at all, so he wrote a note and stuck it on the car window: "I don't know the time! I'm sleepy!" The driver lay down again. But a few minutes later, someone else knocked on the window: "Hey, sir, it's a quarter to one in the afternoon now."

lessons.title: 盘子是这样打碎的
lessons.en: This Is How the Plate Got Broken

paras.zh: 一个小孩儿不小心打碎了一只盘子，盘子非常珍贵。
paras.py: Yí gè xiǎoháir bù xiǎoxīn dǎsuìle yì zhī pánzi, pánzi fēicháng zhēnguì.
paras.en: A little child accidentally broke a plate, and it was a very precious plate.

paras.zh: 妈妈看见了碎片，问：“是谁打碎的？”
paras.py: Māma kànjiànle suìpiàn, wèn: “Shì shéi dǎsuì de?”
paras.en: Mom saw the broken pieces and asked, "Who broke it?"

paras.zh: “是我打碎的。”孩子回答。
paras.py: “Shì wǒ dǎsuì de.” Háizi huídá.
paras.en: "I broke it," the child answered.

paras.zh: “怎么打碎的？”
paras.py: “Zěnme dǎsuì de?”
paras.en: "How did you break it?"

paras.zh: 小孩儿一下子找不到合适的词语，一着急就把另一只盘子也碰到地上，说：“就是这样打碎的！”
paras.py: Xiǎoháir yíxiàzi zhǎo bú dào héshì de cíyǔ, yì zháojí jiù bǎ lìng yì zhī pánzi yě pèngdào dì shang, shuō: “Jiù shì zhèyàng dǎsuì de!”
paras.en: The child couldn't find the right words at once. In a panic, he knocked another plate onto the floor and said, "It broke like this!"

paras.zh: 有一天晚上，你一个人开车，突然，你发现前面有三个人招手。他们都请你停车，这三个人是：
paras.py: Yǒu yì tiān wǎnshang, nǐ yí gè rén kāichē, tūrán, nǐ fāxiàn qiánmiàn yǒu sān gè rén zhāoshǒu. Tāmen dōu qǐng nǐ tíngchē, zhè sān gè rén shì:
paras.en: One night you are driving alone. Suddenly you see three people ahead waving at you. They all ask you to stop. The three people are:

paras.zh: A. 一个受伤的老人；
paras.py: A. Yí gè shòushāng de lǎorén;
paras.en: A. an injured old person;

paras.zh: B. 一个救过你的医生；
paras.py: B. Yí gè jiùguo nǐ de yīshēng;
paras.en: B. a doctor who once saved your life;

paras.zh: C. 一个你很喜欢的人。
paras.py: C. Yí gè nǐ hěn xǐhuan de rén.
paras.en: C. someone you like very much.

paras.zh: 现在的问题是：你的车只能坐两个人。你会怎样选择？你可能选A，帮助最需要帮助的老人；也可能选B，感谢医生救过你；或者选C，跟喜欢的人在一起。
paras.py: Xiànzài de wèntí shì: Nǐ de chē zhǐ néng zuò liǎng gè rén. Nǐ huì zěnyàng xuǎnzé? Nǐ kěnéng xuǎn A, bāngzhù zuì xūyào bāngzhù de lǎorén; yě kěnéng xuǎn B, gǎnxiè yīshēng jiùguo nǐ; huòzhě xuǎn C, gēn xǐhuan de rén zài yìqǐ.
paras.en: Now here is the problem: your car can only take two people. How would you choose? You might choose A, to help the old person who needs help most; or B, to thank the doctor for saving you; or C, to be with the person you like.

paras.zh: 请想一想，还有更好的办法吗？让医生和老人坐在车上，医生开车带老人去医院。然后，你跟喜欢的人在月光下散步。
paras.py: Qǐng xiǎng yi xiǎng, hái yǒu gèng hǎo de bànfǎ ma? Ràng yīshēng hé lǎorén zuò zài chē shang, yīshēng kāichē dài lǎorén qù yīyuàn. Ránhòu, nǐ gēn xǐhuan de rén zài yuèguāng xià sànbù.
paras.en: Think about it: is there a better way? Let the doctor and the old person take the car, and the doctor drives the old person to the hospital. Then you take a walk in the moonlight with the person you like.

lessons.title: 拥抱，不是中国人的习惯
lessons.py: Yōngbào, bú shì Zhōngguórén de xíguàn
lessons.en: Hugging Is Not a Chinese Custom

paras.zh: 在很多西方国家，人们见面的时候，经常互相拥抱。在别的许多国家，也经常拥抱。但是，在亚洲国家，人们还不太习惯拥抱。同样，拥抱也不是中国人的习惯。
paras.py: Zài hěn duō xīfāng guójiā, rénmen jiànmiàn de shíhou, jīngcháng hùxiāng yōngbào. Zài bié de xǔduō guójiā, yě jīngcháng yōngbào. Dànshì, zài Yàzhōu guójiā, rénmen hái bú tài xíguàn yōngbào. Tóngyàng, yōngbào yě bú shì Zhōngguórén de xíguàn.
paras.en: In many Western countries, people often hug each other when they meet. People in many other countries often hug too. But in Asian countries, people are still not very used to hugging. In the same way, hugging is not a Chinese custom.

paras.zh: 在中国，亲人、爱人和好朋友才会互相拥抱。中国人表示友好的方法常常是握手和点头。不熟悉的人，刚认识的人，见面的时候常常握手。握手的时候，要看着对方的眼睛，一边微笑一边握手。朋友见面，一般只点一点头。对不熟悉的人，也可以微笑点头。
paras.py: Zài Zhōngguó, qīnrén, àirén hé hǎo péngyou cái huì hùxiāng yōngbào. Zhōngguórén biǎoshì yǒuhǎo de fāngfǎ chángcháng shì wòshǒu hé diǎntóu. Bù shúxī de rén, gāng rènshi de rén, jiànmiàn de shíhou chángcháng wòshǒu. Wòshǒu de shíhou, yào kànzhe duìfāng de yǎnjing, yìbiān wēixiào yìbiān wòshǒu. Péngyou jiànmiàn, yìbān zhǐ diǎn yi diǎn tóu. Duì bù shúxī de rén, yě kěyǐ wēixiào diǎntóu.
paras.en: In China, only family members, husbands and wives, and close friends hug each other. Chinese people usually show friendliness by shaking hands and nodding. People who don't know each other well, or who have just met, usually shake hands when they meet. When you shake hands, you should look the other person in the eye and smile. When friends meet, they usually just nod. You can also smile and nod to people you don't know well.

paras.zh: 多多是个聪明可爱的孩子，但是有点儿淘气。他经常把家里弄得又脏又乱。多多的爸爸工作很忙，没有时间打扫房间。所以，一般都是多多的妈妈打扫。她特别辛苦。
paras.py: Duōduō shì gè cōngming kě'ài de háizi, dànshì yǒudiǎnr táoqì. Tā jīngcháng bǎ jiā li nòng de yòu zāng yòu luàn. Duōduō de bàba gōngzuò hěn máng, méiyǒu shíjiān dǎsǎo fángjiān. Suǒyǐ, yìbān dōu shì Duōduō de māma dǎsǎo. Tā tèbié xīnkǔ.
paras.en: Duoduo is a clever and lovely child, but a bit naughty. He often makes the home dirty and messy. Duoduo's dad is very busy with work and has no time to clean the rooms. So it is usually Duoduo's mom who cleans. She works very hard.

paras.zh: 有一天，妈妈太累了。怎么办呢？她想到了一个好办法，找来纸和笔，写了几个大字贴在墙上：“讲究卫生，人人有责。”
paras.py: Yǒu yì tiān, māma tài lèi le. Zěnme bàn ne? Tā xiǎngdàole yí gè hǎo bànfǎ, zhǎolái zhǐ hé bǐ, xiěle jǐ gè dà zì tiē zài qiáng shang: “Jiǎngjiu wèishēng, rénrén yǒu zé.”
paras.en: One day, Mom was too tired. What could she do? She thought of a good idea. She got some paper and a pen, wrote a few big characters and stuck them on the wall: "Keeping clean is everyone's (人人) duty."

paras.zh: 多多从学校回家看到墙上的字，想了想，在纸上加了一笔：“讲究卫生，大人有责。”
paras.py: Duōduō cóng xuéxiào huí jiā kàndào qiáng shang de zì, xiǎngle xiǎng, zài zhǐ shang jiāle yì bǐ: “Jiǎngjiu wèishēng, dàrén yǒu zé.”
paras.en: When Duoduo came home from school and saw the words on the wall, he thought for a moment and added one stroke on the paper: "Keeping clean is the grown-ups' (大人) duty." (One stroke turns 人 into 大.)

paras.zh: 晚上，多多的爸爸回家后，一看就知道了。他哈哈一笑，又加上了一笔：“讲究卫生，夫人有责。”
paras.py: Wǎnshang, Duōduō de bàba huí jiā hòu, yí kàn jiù zhīdào le. Tā hāhā yí xiào, yòu jiāshangle yì bǐ: “Jiǎngjiu wèishēng, fūrén yǒu zé.”
paras.en: In the evening, Duoduo's dad came home and understood at a glance. He laughed and added one more stroke: "Keeping clean is the wife's (夫人) duty." (One more stroke turns 大 into 夫, so 大人 "grown-ups" becomes 夫人 "wife".)

paras.zh: 春节是中国人最重要的节日。春节有个习惯，中国人的家里一般都要贴春联。春联常常贴在门上和墙上，所以春节的时候，到处都是红红的春联。
paras.py: Chūnjié shì Zhōngguórén zuì zhòngyào de jiérì. Chūnjié yǒu gè xíguàn, Zhōngguórén de jiā li yìbān dōu yào tiē chūnlián. Chūnlián chángcháng tiē zài mén shang hé qiáng shang, suǒyǐ Chūnjié de shíhou, dàochù dōu shì hónghóng de chūnlián.
paras.en: The Spring Festival is the most important festival for Chinese people. There is a Spring Festival custom: Chinese families usually put up spring couplets. The couplets are often pasted on doors and walls, so during the Spring Festival there are bright red couplets everywhere.

paras.zh: 除了春联，大家还特别喜欢贴“福”字。有些人家故意把“福”字倒过来贴。可是小孩子常常不知道这是为什么。所以，我小时候，有一次看到爸爸把“福”字倒过来贴，就赶紧说：“福倒了！”爸爸说：“对呀，福到了！”那时候，我一下子明白了爸爸为什么要倒着贴“福”字。
paras.py: Chúle chūnlián, dàjiā hái tèbié xǐhuan tiē “fú” zì. Yǒuxiē rénjiā gùyì bǎ “fú” zì dào guòlái tiē. Kěshì xiǎoháizi chángcháng bù zhīdào zhè shì wèi shénme. Suǒyǐ, wǒ xiǎoshíhou, yǒu yí cì kàndào bàba bǎ “fú” zì dào guòlái tiē, jiù gǎnjǐn shuō: “Fú dào le!” Bàba shuō: “Duì ya, fú dào le!” Nà shíhou, wǒ yíxiàzi míngbaile bàba wèi shénme yào dàozhe tiē “fú” zì.
paras.en: Besides couplets, people especially like to put up the character "福" (fú, good fortune). Some families paste it upside down on purpose. But children often don't know why. When I was little, I once saw my dad putting up "福" upside down, and I quickly said, "The 福 is upside down!" (倒了 dào le) Dad said, "That's right, good fortune has arrived!" (到了 dào le, which sounds the same) At that moment, I suddenly understood why Dad put "福" up upside down.

lessons.title: 每天快走30分钟吧
lessons.py: Měi tiān kuài zǒu 30 fēnzhōng ba
lessons.en: Walk Fast for 30 Minutes Every Day

paras.zh: 现在的人学习、工作都很忙，没有时间运动，所以越来越胖。怎么办呢？每天快走5000步就能减肥。没有运动习惯的人，可以爬楼梯、洗车、做家务，这些都能让双脚和全身运动起来。
paras.py: Xiànzài de rén xuéxí, gōngzuò dōu hěn máng, méiyǒu shíjiān yùndòng, suǒyǐ yuèláiyuè pàng. Zěnme bàn ne? Měi tiān kuài zǒu 5000 bù jiù néng jiǎnféi. Méiyǒu yùndòng xíguàn de rén, kěyǐ pá lóutī, xǐ chē, zuò jiāwù, zhèxiē dōu néng ràng shuāng jiǎo hé quánshēn yùndòng qǐlái.
paras.en: People today are busy with study and work and have no time to exercise, so they are getting fatter and fatter. What can be done? Walking fast for 5,000 steps a day can help you lose weight. People who don't usually exercise can climb stairs, wash the car or do housework. All of these get your feet and your whole body moving.

paras.zh: 快走运动是最方便的减肥运动。你可以用100—120步/分钟左右的速度走，每天走30分钟就行。如果你一次没有那么多时间，也可以利用3—5分钟的时间，每天加起来走5000步，2—3个月后就会有很好的效果了。
paras.py: Kuài zǒu yùndòng shì zuì fāngbiàn de jiǎnféi yùndòng. Nǐ kěyǐ yòng 100-120 bù/fēnzhōng zuǒyòu de sùdù zǒu, měi tiān zǒu 30 fēnzhōng jiù xíng. Rúguǒ nǐ yí cì méiyǒu nàme duō shíjiān, yě kěyǐ lìyòng 3-5 fēnzhōng de shíjiān, měi tiān jiā qǐlái zǒu 5000 bù, 2-3 gè yuè hòu jiù huì yǒu hěn hǎo de xiàoguǒ le.
paras.en: Fast walking is the easiest exercise for losing weight. Walk at about 100–120 steps per minute; 30 minutes a day is enough. If you don't have that much time at once, you can use 3–5 minutes at a time and add them up to 5,000 steps a day. After 2–3 months you will see very good results.

paras.zh: 有位法国朋友说：“中国实在太奇妙了，尤其是在语言文字方面，太有意思了！比如‘中国队大胜法国队’，意思是中国胜了。假如说‘中国队大败法国队’，你们又说中国胜了。总之，胜利永远是你们的。”
paras.py: Yǒu wèi Fǎguó péngyou shuō: “Zhōngguó shízài tài qímiào le, yóuqí shì zài yǔyán wénzì fāngmiàn, tài yǒu yìsi le! Bǐrú ‘Zhōngguóduì dà shèng Fǎguóduì’, yìsi shì Zhōngguó shèng le. Jiǎrú shuō ‘Zhōngguóduì dà bài Fǎguóduì’, nǐmen yòu shuō Zhōngguó shèng le. Zǒngzhī, shènglì yǒngyuǎn shì nǐmen de.”
paras.en: A French friend said, "China is really amazing, especially its language and writing. It's so interesting! For example, '中国队大胜法国队' (dà shèng, "won big") means China won. But if you say '中国队大败法国队' (dà bài, "lost big" or "beat badly"), you also say China won. In short, you always win!"

paras.zh: 这样的例子在汉语中还有不少：
paras.py: Zhèyàng de lìzi zài Hànyǔ zhōng hái yǒu bù shǎo:
paras.en: There are quite a few examples like this in Chinese:

paras.zh: 例1：在“今晚我差点儿迟到”和“今晚我差点儿没迟到”这两句话中，最后“我”都没有迟到。
paras.py: Lì 1: Zài “Jīnwǎn wǒ chàdiǎnr chídào” hé “Jīnwǎn wǒ chàdiǎnr méi chídào” zhè liǎng jù huà zhōng, zuìhòu “wǒ” dōu méiyǒu chídào.
paras.en: Example 1: In both "今晚我差点儿迟到" ("I was almost late tonight") and "今晚我差点儿没迟到" (word for word, "I almost wasn't late tonight"), "I" was not late in the end.

paras.zh: 例2：“这次考试我好容易得了100分”和“这次考试我好不容易得了100分”这两句话的意思，也完全一样。
paras.py: Lì 2: “Zhè cì kǎoshì wǒ hǎo róngyì déle 100 fēn” hé “Zhè cì kǎoshì wǒ hǎo bù róngyì déle 100 fēn” zhè liǎng jù huà de yìsi, yě wánquán yíyàng.
paras.en: Example 2: "这次考试我好容易得了100分" and "这次考试我好不容易得了100分" also mean exactly the same: "It was hard, but I got 100 on this test." (好容易 looks like "very easy" and 好不容易 like "not easy", yet both mean "with great difficulty".)

paras.zh: 你说中文奇妙不奇妙？
paras.py: Nǐ shuō Zhōngwén qímiào bù qímiào?
paras.en: Tell me, isn't Chinese amazing?

lessons.title: 狐假虎威
lessons.en: The Fox Borrows the Tiger's Might

paras.zh: 有一天，一只老虎非常饿。突然，它发现了一只狐狸。老虎抓住狐狸，想吃了它。狐狸想出了一个办法，它对老虎说：“你不能吃我，因为我是森林之王，动物们都怕我。”老虎不相信狐狸的话。狐狸又说：“我们一起在森林里走一走，看看动物们怕不怕我。”
paras.py: Yǒu yì tiān, yì zhī lǎohǔ fēicháng è. Tūrán, tā fāxiànle yì zhī húli. Lǎohǔ zhuāzhù húli, xiǎng chīle tā. Húli xiǎngchūle yí gè bànfǎ, tā duì lǎohǔ shuō: “Nǐ bù néng chī wǒ, yīnwèi wǒ shì sēnlín zhī wáng, dòngwùmen dōu pà wǒ.” Lǎohǔ bù xiāngxìn húli de huà. Húli yòu shuō: “Wǒmen yìqǐ zài sēnlín li zǒu yi zǒu, kànkan dòngwùmen pà bu pà wǒ.”
paras.en: One day, a tiger was very hungry. Suddenly it found a fox. The tiger caught the fox and wanted to eat it. The fox came up with an idea and said to the tiger, "You can't eat me, because I'm the king of the forest. All the animals are afraid of me." The tiger didn't believe the fox. The fox said, "Let's take a walk in the forest together and see whether the animals are afraid of me."

paras.zh: 于是，狐狸在前面走，老虎在后面走。森林里的兔子、羊看到它们，都马上跑了。
paras.py: Yúshì, húli zài qiánmiàn zǒu, lǎohǔ zài hòumiàn zǒu. Sēnlín li de tùzi, yáng kàndào tāmen, dōu mǎshàng pǎo le.
paras.en: So the fox walked in front and the tiger walked behind. When the rabbits and sheep in the forest saw them, they all ran away at once.

paras.zh: 愚蠢的老虎相信了狐狸的话，它不知道动物们怕的是自己。
paras.py: Yúchǔn de lǎohǔ xiāngxìnle húli de huà, tā bù zhīdào dòngwùmen pà de shì zìjǐ.
paras.en: The foolish tiger believed the fox. It didn't know that the animals were really afraid of the tiger itself.

lessons.title: 等待红灯变绿灯
lessons.en: Waiting for the Red Light to Turn Green

paras.zh: 有个留学生叫马可，他有个中国女朋友。有一天，女朋友请马可到家里来吃饭。女朋友家的门口，挂着两个红红的大灯笼。
paras.py: Yǒu gè liúxuéshēng jiào Mǎkě, tā yǒu gè Zhōngguó nǚpéngyou. Yǒu yì tiān, nǚpéngyou qǐng Mǎkě dào jiā li lái chīfàn. Nǚpéngyou jiā de ménkǒu, guàzhe liǎng gè hónghóng de dà dēnglong.
paras.en: There was an international student named Marco who had a Chinese girlfriend. One day, his girlfriend invited him to her home for a meal. Two big red lanterns hung at the door of her house.

paras.zh: 早上九点，马可手里就拿着玫瑰到了女朋友家的门口。他看到红红的灯笼，就站在那里等待，一直没有进去。过了很长时间，他的女朋友很着急，于是给马可打电话。马可说：“我已经到你家门口了。”女朋友觉得很奇怪，说：“那你为什么不进来？”马可说：“你家门口有两个红灯笼，我正在等待红灯变绿灯呢。”
paras.py: Zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn, Mǎkě shǒu li jiù názhe méigui dàole nǚpéngyou jiā de ménkǒu. Tā kàndào hónghóng de dēnglong, jiù zhàn zài nàli děngdài, yìzhí méiyǒu jìnqù. Guòle hěn cháng shíjiān, tā de nǚpéngyou hěn zháojí, yúshì gěi Mǎkě dǎ diànhuà. Mǎkě shuō: “Wǒ yǐjīng dào nǐ jiā ménkǒu le.” Nǚpéngyou juéde hěn qíguài, shuō: “Nà nǐ wèi shénme bú jìnlái?” Mǎkě shuō: “Nǐ jiā ménkǒu yǒu liǎng gè hóng dēnglong, wǒ zhèngzài děngdài hóngdēng biàn lǜdēng ne.”
paras.en: At nine in the morning, Marco was already at her door with roses in his hand. When he saw the red lanterns, he stood there waiting and didn't go in. After a long time, his girlfriend got worried and phoned him. Marco said, "I'm already at your door." She thought it was strange and said, "Then why don't you come in?" Marco said, "There are two red lanterns at your door. I'm waiting for the red light to turn green." (红灯 hóngdēng means both "red lantern" and "red traffic light".)

paras.zh: 有一天，我问儿子：“你长大后想当什么？”
paras.py: Yǒu yì tiān, wǒ wèn érzi: “Nǐ zhǎngdà hòu xiǎng dāng shénme?”
paras.en: One day I asked my son, "What do you want to be when you grow up?"

paras.zh: 儿子回答说：“爸爸，我长大后要当北极探险家。”
paras.py: Érzi huídá shuō: “Bàba, wǒ zhǎngdà hòu yào dāng Běijí tànxiǎnjiā.”
paras.en: My son answered, "Dad, when I grow up I want to be an Arctic explorer."

paras.zh: 我很高兴：“好极了！”
paras.py: Wǒ hěn gāoxìng: “Hǎo jí le!”
paras.en: I was very happy: "Excellent!"

paras.zh: 儿子又说：“我想马上开始训练。”
paras.py: Érzi yòu shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng mǎshàng kāishǐ xùnliàn.”
paras.en: My son went on, "I want to start training right away."

paras.zh: 我觉得很奇怪：“怎么训练？”
paras.py: Wǒ juéde hěn qíguài: “Zěnme xùnliàn?”
paras.en: I was puzzled: "How will you train?"

paras.zh: 儿子回答：“北极非常冷，我每天吃一桶冰激凌，就能适应那儿的温度了。”
paras.py: Érzi huídá: “Běijí fēicháng lěng, wǒ měi tiān chī yì tǒng bīngjīlíng, jiù néng shìyìng nàr de wēndù le.”
paras.en: My son answered, "The Arctic is very cold. If I eat a tub of ice cream every day, I'll get used to the temperature there."

paras.zh: 大熊猫的数量非常少。现在全世界只有一千多只。大熊猫的样子很可爱。它们的身体是黑色和白色的，又圆又胖，特别是它们的黑眼圈和圆脑袋很有趣。大熊猫喜欢吃竹子、胡萝卜，它们的动作很慢。
paras.py: Dàxióngmāo de shùliàng fēicháng shǎo. Xiànzài quán shìjiè zhǐ yǒu yìqiān duō zhī. Dàxióngmāo de yàngzi hěn kě'ài. Tāmen de shēntǐ shì hēisè hé báisè de, yòu yuán yòu pàng, tèbié shì tāmen de hēi yǎnquān hé yuán nǎodai hěn yǒuqù. Dàxióngmāo xǐhuan chī zhúzi, húluóbo, tāmen de dòngzuò hěn màn.
paras.en: There are very few giant pandas. Today there are only a little over a thousand in the whole world. Pandas look very cute. Their bodies are black and white, round and chubby. Their black eye patches and round heads are especially fun. Pandas like to eat bamboo and carrots, and they move very slowly.

paras.zh: 因为大熊猫数量少，样子可爱，而且只生长在中国，所以人们说大熊猫是中国的“国宝”。为了向外国朋友表示友好，从1957年到1982年，中国一共送给9个国家23只大熊猫。现在，在美国、德国、日本等国家都有中国的大熊猫。
paras.py: Yīnwèi dàxióngmāo shùliàng shǎo, yàngzi kě'ài, érqiě zhǐ shēngzhǎng zài Zhōngguó, suǒyǐ rénmen shuō dàxióngmāo shì Zhōngguó de “guóbǎo”. Wèile xiàng wàiguó péngyou biǎoshì yǒuhǎo, cóng 1957 nián dào 1982 nián, Zhōngguó yígòng sòng gěi 9 gè guójiā 23 zhī dàxióngmāo. Xiànzài, zài Měiguó, Déguó, Rìběn děng guójiā dōu yǒu Zhōngguó de dàxióngmāo.
paras.en: Because pandas are few, look cute and live only in China, people call them China's "national treasure". To show friendship to other countries, from 1957 to 1982 China gave 23 pandas to 9 countries in all. Today there are Chinese pandas in the US, Germany, Japan and other countries.

lessons.title: 我就知道你会这么做！
lessons.py: Wǒ jiù zhīdào nǐ huì zhème zuò!
lessons.en: I Knew You Would Do That!

paras.zh: 王太太有两个儿子，小的五岁，大的七岁。一个星期天的上午，她正在洗衣服，小儿子走过来说：“妈妈，我想吃糖。”
paras.py: Wáng tàitai yǒu liǎng gè érzi, xiǎo de wǔ suì, dà de qī suì. Yí gè xīngqītiān de shàngwǔ, tā zhèngzài xǐ yīfu, xiǎo érzi zǒu guòlái shuō: “Māma, wǒ xiǎng chī táng.”
paras.en: Mrs. Wang had two sons. The younger one was five and the older one was seven. One Sunday morning, she was washing clothes when her younger son came over and said, "Mom, I want some candy."

paras.zh: 王太太想了想，说：“糖吃多了对牙不好，吃苹果吧，一个给哥哥。”说完，给他两个苹果。这两个苹果一个大，一个小。小儿子把小的给了哥哥，大的留给了自己。
paras.py: Wáng tàitai xiǎngle xiǎng, shuō: “Táng chī duōle duì yá bù hǎo, chī píngguǒ ba, yí gè gěi gēge.” Shuō wán, gěi tā liǎng gè píngguǒ. Zhè liǎng gè píngguǒ yí gè dà, yí gè xiǎo. Xiǎo érzi bǎ xiǎo de gěile gēge, dà de liú gěile zìjǐ.
paras.en: Mrs. Wang thought for a moment and said, "Too much candy is bad for your teeth. Have an apple instead, and give one to your brother." Then she gave him two apples, one big and one small. The younger son gave the small one to his brother and kept the big one for himself.

paras.zh: 哥哥看到弟弟的苹果大，就对弟弟说：“自己挑大的太自私了。要是妈妈给我这两个苹果，我一定把大的给你。”
paras.py: Gēge kàndào dìdi de píngguǒ dà, jiù duì dìdi shuō: “Zìjǐ tiāo dà de tài zìsī le. Yàoshi māma gěi wǒ zhè liǎng gè píngguǒ, wǒ yídìng bǎ dà de gěi nǐ.”
paras.en: When the older brother saw that his little brother's apple was bigger, he said, "Picking the big one for yourself is too selfish. If Mom had given me these two apples, I would definitely have given you the big one."

paras.zh: “我就知道你会这么做。”弟弟回答说：“所以我拿了大的。”
paras.py: “Wǒ jiù zhīdào nǐ huì zhème zuò.” Dìdi huídá shuō: “Suǒyǐ wǒ nále dà de.”
paras.en: "I knew you would do that," the younger brother answered. "That's why I took the big one."

paras.zh: 肯德基是一家有名的洋快餐。从2008年1月开始，肯德基的早餐有了油条——一种中国的传统食品。
paras.py: Kěndéjī shì yì jiā yǒumíng de yáng kuàicān. Cóng 2008 nián 1 yuè kāishǐ, Kěndéjī de zǎocān yǒule yóutiáo—yì zhǒng Zhōngguó de chuántǒng shípǐn.
paras.en: KFC is a famous Western fast-food chain. Starting in January 2008, KFC's breakfast included youtiao (deep-fried dough sticks), a traditional Chinese food.

paras.zh: 对肯德基卖油条这件事，人们有不同的看法。有人说：“肯德基卖油条也可以，这样我们吃早餐就多了一个选择。”但有的人说：“肯德基卖油条，我总是觉得有点儿奇怪。”还有的人说：“肯德基的油条应该更好吃！”还有的人说：“肯德基的油条三元一根，太贵了，应该便宜点儿。”
paras.py: Duì Kěndéjī mài yóutiáo zhè jiàn shì, rénmen yǒu bù tóng de kànfǎ. Yǒu rén shuō: “Kěndéjī mài yóutiáo yě kěyǐ, zhèyàng wǒmen chī zǎocān jiù duōle yí gè xuǎnzé.” Dàn yǒu de rén shuō: “Kěndéjī mài yóutiáo, wǒ zǒngshì juéde yǒudiǎnr qíguài.” Hái yǒu de rén shuō: “Kěndéjī de yóutiáo yīnggāi gèng hǎochī!” Hái yǒu de rén shuō: “Kěndéjī de yóutiáo sān yuán yì gēn, tài guì le, yīnggāi piányi diǎnr.”
paras.en: People have different views about KFC selling youtiao. Some say, "It's fine for KFC to sell youtiao. Now we have one more choice for breakfast." But others say, "KFC selling youtiao always feels a bit strange to me." Some say, "KFC's youtiao should taste better!" And others say, "KFC's youtiao cost three yuan each. That's too expensive. They should be cheaper."

paras.zh: 美国前总统卡特竞选的时候，一位爱找麻烦的女记者访问了他的母亲。
paras.py: Měiguó qián zǒngtǒng Kǎtè jìngxuǎn de shíhou, yí wèi ài zhǎo máfan de nǚ jìzhě fǎngwènle tā de mǔqīn.
paras.en: When former US President Carter was running for election, a woman reporter who liked to cause trouble interviewed his mother.

paras.zh: 女记者问：“你儿子说，如果他说谎，那么大家就不要选他。你敢说你儿子从来没有说过谎？”
paras.py: Nǚ jìzhě wèn: “Nǐ érzi shuō, rúguǒ tā shuōhuǎng, nàme dàjiā jiù bú yào xuǎn tā. Nǐ gǎn shuō nǐ érzi cónglái méiyǒu shuōguo huǎng?”
paras.en: The reporter asked, "Your son says that if he lies, people shouldn't vote for him. Can you really say your son has never told a lie?"

paras.zh: 卡特的母亲回答说：“也许我儿子说过谎，但都是善意的。”
paras.py: Kǎtè de mǔqīn huídá shuō: “Yěxǔ wǒ érzi shuōguo huǎng, dàn dōu shì shànyì de.”
paras.en: Carter's mother answered, "Maybe my son has told lies, but they were all kind ones."

paras.zh: “什么是善意的谎话？”
paras.py: “Shénme shì shànyì de huǎnghuà?”
paras.en: "What is a kind lie?"

paras.zh: “你记得吗，几分钟之前，当你进来的时候，我对你说：‘你真漂亮，我见到你很高兴。’这就是善意的谎话。”
paras.py: “Nǐ jìde ma, jǐ fēnzhōng zhīqián, dāng nǐ jìnlái de shíhou, wǒ duì nǐ shuō: ‘Nǐ zhēn piàoliang, wǒ jiàndào nǐ hěn gāoxìng.’ Zhè jiù shì shànyì de huǎnghuà.”
paras.en: "Do you remember? A few minutes ago, when you came in, I said to you, 'You're very pretty, and I'm very glad to see you.' That is a kind lie."

lessons.title: 冰岛人为什么长寿？
lessons.en: Why Do Icelanders Live So Long?

paras.zh: 冰岛是一个国家，它在寒冷的北大西洋上。13%的土地上是冰雪。冰岛冬天的夜晚很长，每天有20个小时。
paras.py: Bīngdǎo shì yí gè guójiā, tā zài hánlěng de Běi Dàxīyáng shang. 13% de tǔdì shang shì bīngxuě. Bīngdǎo dōngtiān de yèwǎn hěn cháng, měi tiān yǒu 20 gè xiǎoshí.
paras.en: Iceland is a country in the cold North Atlantic Ocean. 13% of its land is covered with ice and snow. Winter nights in Iceland are very long: 20 hours a day.

paras.zh: 生活在这样寒冷的地方，冰岛人的平均寿命却是世界上最长的。为什么呢？
paras.py: Shēnghuó zài zhèyàng hánlěng de dìfang, Bīngdǎorén de píngjūn shòumìng què shì shìjiè shang zuì cháng de. Wèi shénme ne?
paras.en: Although they live in such a cold place, Icelanders have the longest average life span in the world. Why?

paras.zh: 为了得到这个问题的答案，美国的一个调查组织，对世界上18个国家的人作了一次调查，结果是：冰岛人是世界上最快乐的人。参加调查的27万冰岛人中，82%都对自己的生活很满意。
paras.py: Wèile dédào zhège wèntí de dá'àn, Měiguó de yí gè diàochá zǔzhī, duì shìjiè shang 18 gè guójiā de rén zuòle yí cì diàochá, jiéguǒ shì: Bīngdǎorén shì shìjiè shang zuì kuàilè de rén. Cānjiā diàochá de 27 wàn Bīngdǎorén zhōng, 82% dōu duì zìjǐ de shēnghuó hěn mǎnyì.
paras.en: To find the answer, an American research organization did a survey of people in 18 countries. The result: Icelanders are the happiest people in the world. Of the 270,000 Icelanders in the survey, 82% were very happy with their lives.

paras.zh: 知道吗？冰岛人因为快乐，所以长寿，快乐是人们心里的阳光。
paras.py: Zhīdào ma? Bīngdǎorén yīnwèi kuàilè, suǒyǐ chángshòu, kuàilè shì rénmen xīnli de yángguāng.
paras.en: You see? Icelanders live long because they are happy. Happiness is the sunshine in people's hearts.

paras.zh: 有个南方人，第一次到北方城市哈尔滨，想找个住的地方。他问一个哈尔滨人：“请问哪里有旅馆？”
paras.py: Yǒu gè nánfāngrén, dì-yī cì dào běifāng chéngshì Hā'ěrbīn, xiǎng zhǎo gè zhù de dìfang. Tā wèn yí gè Hā'ěrbīnrén: “Qǐngwèn nǎli yǒu lǚguǎn?”
paras.en: A man from the south went to the northern city of Harbin for the first time and wanted to find a place to stay. He asked a local, "Excuse me, where can I find a hotel?"

paras.zh: 哈尔滨人热情地告诉他：“这里的旅馆贼多！”
paras.py: Hā'ěrbīnrén rèqíng de gàosu tā: “Zhèli de lǚguǎn zéi duō!”
paras.en: The Harbin man told him warmly, "Hotels here are 贼多 (zéi duō)!" (In northeastern slang 贼 means "very", so this means "There are lots of hotels!" But 贼 usually means "thief", so it also sounds like "Hotels here have lots of thieves!")

paras.zh: 南方人说：“旅馆贼多，那我就找饭店。”
paras.py: Nánfāngrén shuō: “Lǚguǎn zéi duō, nà wǒ jiù zhǎo fàndiàn.”
paras.en: The southerner said, "If the hotels have lots of thieves, then I'll look for a 饭店 (another kind of hotel)."

paras.zh: 哈尔滨人又告诉他：“饭店同样贼多。”
paras.py: Hā'ěrbīnrén yòu gàosu tā: “Fàndiàn tóngyàng zéi duō.”
paras.en: The Harbin man told him, "饭店 are 贼多 too."

paras.zh: 南方人说：“贼多的地方就不去了，我想找个酒吧。”
paras.py: Nánfāngrén shuō: “Zéi duō de dìfang jiù bú qù le, wǒ xiǎng zhǎo gè jiǔbā.”
paras.en: The southerner said, "I won't go anywhere with lots of thieves. I'll look for a bar."

paras.zh: 哈尔滨人又告诉他：“酒吧同样贼多。”
paras.py: Hā'ěrbīnrén yòu gàosu tā: “Jiǔbā tóngyàng zéi duō.”
paras.en: The Harbin man told him, "Bars are 贼多 too."

paras.zh: 南方人很惊讶：“啊？这里贼这么多，那我怎么办？”
paras.py: Nánfāngrén hěn jīngyà: “À? Zhèli zéi zhème duō, nà wǒ zěnme bàn?”
paras.en: The southerner was shocked: "What? There are so many thieves here! What am I going to do?"

paras.zh: 哈尔滨人哈哈大笑，说：“误会了，误会了。‘贼多’的‘贼’，意思不是‘小偷’，而是‘很’，所以‘贼多’就是‘很多’的意思。”
paras.py: Hā'ěrbīnrén hāhā dà xiào, shuō: “Wùhuì le, wùhuì le. ‘Zéi duō’ de ‘zéi’, yìsi bú shì ‘xiǎotōu’, ér shì ‘hěn’, suǒyǐ ‘zéi duō’ jiù shì ‘hěn duō’ de yìsi.”
paras.en: The Harbin man laughed out loud and said, "You've got it wrong! The 贼 in '贼多' doesn't mean 'thief'. It means 'very'. So '贼多' just means 'very many'."

lessons.title: 环保征文第一名
lessons.en: First Prize in an Environmental Writing Contest

paras.zh: 在一次关于环境保护的征文活动中，因为奖金特别高，所以参加的人非常多。其中，很多人的文章写得很好。但让人吃惊的是，得到第一名的却是一个中学生。
paras.py: Zài yí cì guānyú huánjìng bǎohù de zhēngwén huódòng zhōng, yīnwèi jiǎngjīn tèbié gāo, suǒyǐ cānjiā de rén fēicháng duō. Qízhōng, hěn duō rén de wénzhāng xiě de hěn hǎo. Dàn ràng rén chījīng de shì, dédào dì-yī míng de què shì yí gè zhōngxuéshēng.
paras.en: In a writing competition about protecting the environment, the prize money was very high, so a great many people took part. Many of them wrote very good essays. But surprisingly, first prize went to a middle school student.

paras.zh: 那么一篇一般的文章，为什么能够得到第一名呢？一位工作人员说：“他的文章也比不上最好的，但是，在所有的人中，只有他一个人的文章是双面打印的。我们都知道，双面打印可以节约很多纸。而如果能节约4000张纸，就可以保护一棵树。所以，只有他才做到了环保！”
paras.py: Nàme yì piān yìbān de wénzhāng, wèi shénme nénggòu dédào dì-yī míng ne? Yí wèi gōngzuò rényuán shuō: “Tā de wénzhāng yě bǐ bu shàng zuì hǎo de, dànshì, zài suǒyǒu de rén zhōng, zhǐ yǒu tā yí gè rén de wénzhāng shì shuāngmiàn dǎyìn de. Wǒmen dōu zhīdào, shuāngmiàn dǎyìn kěyǐ jiéyuē hěn duō zhǐ. Ér rúguǒ néng jiéyuē 4000 zhāng zhǐ, jiù kěyǐ bǎohù yì kē shù. Suǒyǐ, zhǐ yǒu tā cái zuòdàole huánbǎo!”
paras.en: So why could an ordinary essay win first prize? A staff member said, "His essay wasn't as good as the best ones. But of all the people who entered, he was the only one whose essay was printed on both sides. We all know that double-sided printing saves a lot of paper. And if you can save 4,000 sheets of paper, you can save a tree. So he was the only one who really protected the environment!"

paras.zh: 去年，我开始了在上海的留学生活。刚开始，我觉得汉语很难，加之想念家人，所以心情很不好。一天晚上，我喝了很多酒，在宿舍楼下的椅子上睡着了。“同学，你喝醉了吗？”一位服务员用温柔的声音叫醒我，“你是第一次来中国吧？是不是想家了？”我的眼泪一下子流了出来。
paras.py: Qùnián, wǒ kāishǐle zài Shànghǎi de liúxué shēnghuó. Gāng kāishǐ, wǒ juéde Hànyǔ hěn nán, jiāzhī xiǎngniàn jiārén, suǒyǐ xīnqíng hěn bù hǎo. Yì tiān wǎnshang, wǒ hēle hěn duō jiǔ, zài sùshè lóu xià de yǐzi shang shuìzháo le. “Tóngxué, nǐ hēzuì le ma?” Yí wèi fúwùyuán yòng wēnróu de shēngyīn jiàoxǐng wǒ, “Nǐ shì dì-yī cì lái Zhōngguó ba? Shì bu shì xiǎng jiā le?” Wǒ de yǎnlèi yíxiàzi liúle chūlái.
paras.en: Last year, I began my life as a student in Shanghai. At first, I found Chinese very hard, and I also missed my family, so I was very unhappy. One night I drank a lot and fell asleep on a bench outside my dorm. "Hey, are you drunk?" A staff member woke me in a gentle voice. "Is this your first time in China? Are you homesick?" Suddenly tears ran down my face.

paras.zh: 第二天，我又见到了那位服务员。她一见面就说：“嗨，你现在好些了吗？”她还热情地给了我一块儿小点心。我又流泪了！这是我在上海收到的第一件礼物——一颗理解的心。
paras.py: Dì-èr tiān, wǒ yòu jiàndàole nà wèi fúwùyuán. Tā yí jiànmiàn jiù shuō: “Hāi, nǐ xiànzài hǎo xiē le ma?” Tā hái rèqíng de gěile wǒ yí kuàir xiǎo diǎnxin. Wǒ yòu liúlèi le! Zhè shì wǒ zài Shànghǎi shōudào de dì-yī jiàn lǐwù—yì kē lǐjiě de xīn.
paras.en: The next day, I saw her again. As soon as she saw me, she said, "Hi, are you feeling better now?" She also kindly gave me a little snack. I cried again! This was the first gift I received in Shanghai: an understanding heart.

paras.zh: 这个礼物让我决定，我要继续学下去。
paras.py: Zhège lǐwù ràng wǒ juédìng, wǒ yào jìxù xué xiàqù.
paras.en: This gift made me decide to keep on studying.

paras.zh: 一
paras.py: Yī
paras.en: One

paras.name: 男A
paras.zh: “同学，你好！我可以向你问路吗？”
paras.py: “Tóngxué, nǐ hǎo! Wǒ kěyǐ xiàng nǐ wènlù ma?”
paras.en: "Hi there! May I ask you the way?"

paras.name: 女A
paras.zh: “到哪里？”
paras.py: “Dào nǎli?”
paras.en: "To where?"

paras.name: 男A
paras.zh: “到你心里。”
paras.py: “Dào nǐ xīnli.”
paras.en: "To your heart."

paras.name: 女A
paras.zh: “对不起，此路不通。”
paras.py: “Duìbuqǐ, cǐ lù bù tōng.”
paras.en: "Sorry, that road is closed."

paras.zh: 二
paras.py: Èr
paras.en: Two

paras.name: 男B
paras.zh: “小姐，你的腿一定很累吧！”
paras.py: “Xiǎojiě, nǐ de tuǐ yídìng hěn lèi ba!”
paras.en: "Miss, your legs must be very tired!"

paras.name: 女B
paras.zh: “为什么？”
paras.py: “Wèi shénme?”
paras.en: "Why?"

paras.name: 男B
paras.zh: “因为你在我脑袋里跑了一天。”
paras.py: “Yīnwèi nǐ zài wǒ nǎodai li pǎole yì tiān.”
paras.en: "Because you've been running around in my head all day."

paras.name: 女B
paras.zh: “我觉得没问题，因为你的脑袋真的太小了。”
paras.py: “Wǒ juéde méi wèntí, yīnwèi nǐ de nǎodai zhēn de tài xiǎo le.”
paras.en: "I think they're fine, because your head is really too small."

paras.zh: 三
paras.py: Sān
paras.en: Three

paras.name: 男C
paras.zh: “同学，我可以用一下你的手机吗？”
paras.py: “Tóngxué, wǒ kěyǐ yòng yíxià nǐ de shǒujī ma?”
paras.en: "Excuse me, may I use your phone?"

paras.name: 女C
paras.zh: “你要做什么？”
paras.py: “Nǐ yào zuò shénme?”
paras.en: "What for?"

paras.name: 男C
paras.zh: “我要给朋友打电话，说我今天看到了世界上最漂亮的女孩儿。”
paras.py: “Wǒ yào gěi péngyou dǎ diànhuà, shuō wǒ jīntiān kàndàole shìjiè shang zuì piàoliang de nǚháir.”
paras.en: "I want to call a friend and tell him that today I saw the most beautiful girl in the world."

paras.name: 女C
paras.zh: “对不起，我不能借给你。”
paras.py: “Duìbuqǐ, wǒ bù néng jiè gěi nǐ.”
paras.en: "Sorry, I can't lend it to you."

paras.name: 男C
paras.zh: “为什么？”
paras.py: “Wèi shénme?”
paras.en: "Why not?"

paras.name: 女C
paras.zh: “因为我也要给朋友打电话，告诉她我看到了一只青蛙，很害怕。”
paras.py: “Yīnwèi wǒ yě yào gěi péngyou dǎ diànhuà, gàosu tā wǒ kàndàole yì zhī qīngwā, hěn hàipà.”
paras.en: "Because I need to call my friend too, to tell her I saw a frog and I'm scared."

paras.zh: “孟”是一个有趣的汉字。它的上边是“子”，下边是“皿”。“子”是一个孩子，“皿”是一种像盆一样的东西。“子”和“皿”放在一起，很容易让人想到孩子洗澡。
paras.py: “Mèng” shì yí gè yǒuqù de Hànzì. Tā de shàngbian shì “zǐ”, xiàbian shì “mǐn”. “Zǐ” shì yí gè háizi, “mǐn” shì yì zhǒng xiàng pén yíyàng de dōngxi. “Zǐ” hé “mǐn” fàng zài yìqǐ, hěn róngyì ràng rén xiǎngdào háizi xǐzǎo.
paras.en: "孟" (mèng) is an interesting character. Its top part is "子" (zǐ) and its bottom part is "皿" (mǐn). "子" is a child, and "皿" is something like a basin. When "子" and "皿" are put together, it's easy to think of a child having a bath.

paras.zh: 孩子出生后，第一件事就是洗澡。所以，“孟”字就有“刚刚出生”的意思。“孟春”就是春天的第一个月。家里长子的名字有时也用“孟”字。当然，“孟”也是一个姓。例如，中国古代有位很有名的思想家就叫孟子。
paras.py: Háizi chūshēng hòu, dì-yī jiàn shì jiù shì xǐzǎo. Suǒyǐ, “mèng” zì jiù yǒu “gānggāng chūshēng” de yìsi. “Mèngchūn” jiù shì chūntiān de dì-yī gè yuè. Jiā li zhǎngzǐ de míngzi yǒushí yě yòng “mèng” zì. Dāngrán, “Mèng” yě shì yí gè xìng. Lìrú, Zhōngguó gǔdài yǒu wèi hěn yǒumíng de sīxiǎngjiā jiù jiào Mèngzǐ.
paras.en: After a baby is born, the first thing it gets is a bath. So the character "孟" has the meaning "just born". "孟春" is the first month of spring. The eldest son of a family sometimes has "孟" in his name too. Of course, "孟" (Meng) is also a family name. For example, a very famous thinker in ancient China was called Mencius (孟子 Mengzi).

paras.zh: 齐白石是中国著名的画家，他画的虾非常有名。晚年的时候，他在北京画虾，挣钱一元一只。大多数人不讲价。但是有一天，一位先生给了四元五角钱，要求齐白石画五只虾。
paras.py: Qí Báishí shì Zhōngguó zhùmíng de huàjiā, tā huà de xiā fēicháng yǒumíng. Wǎnnián de shíhou, tā zài Běijīng huà xiā, zhèng qián yì yuán yì zhī. Dàduōshù rén bù jiǎngjià. Dànshì yǒu yì tiān, yí wèi xiānsheng gěile sì yuán wǔ jiǎo qián, yāoqiú Qí Báishí huà wǔ zhī xiā.
paras.en: Qi Baishi was a famous Chinese painter, and his paintings of shrimps were very well known. In his old age he painted shrimps in Beijing and charged one yuan per shrimp. Most people didn't bargain. But one day, a man gave him four and a half yuan and asked him to paint five shrimps.

paras.zh: 很快，四只虾画好了。然而，齐白石在画纸的右上角又加了一只，但是这只虾只有半个身子，好像在向另外四只虾游过来一样。那位先生开玩笑说：“白石老人真是小气，多收了我五角钱，还画了半只虾！”
paras.py: Hěn kuài, sì zhī xiā huà hǎo le. Rán'ér, Qí Báishí zài huàzhǐ de yòushàngjiǎo yòu jiāle yì zhī, dànshì zhè zhī xiā zhǐ yǒu bàn gè shēnzi, hǎoxiàng zài xiàng lìngwài sì zhī xiā yóu guòlái yíyàng. Nà wèi xiānsheng kāi wánxiào shuō: “Báishí lǎorén zhēn shì xiǎoqi, duō shōule wǒ wǔ jiǎo qián, hái huàle bàn zhī xiā!”
paras.en: Soon four shrimps were done. Then Qi Baishi added one more in the top right corner of the paper, but this shrimp had only half a body, as if it were swimming toward the other four. The man joked, "Old Baishi, you're really stingy! You charged me an extra fifty cents and still painted only half a shrimp!"

paras.zh: 齐白石说：“纸上不是四只半虾，也不是五只虾，而是一群虾。它们正跟着那只露出半个身子的虾游过来呢。”
paras.py: Qí Báishí shuō: “Zhǐ shang bú shì sì zhī bàn xiā, yě bú shì wǔ zhī xiā, ér shì yì qún xiā. Tāmen zhèng gēnzhe nà zhī lùchū bàn gè shēnzi de xiā yóu guòlái ne.”
paras.en: Qi Baishi said, "On the paper there aren't four and a half shrimps, or five shrimps, but a whole group of shrimps. They are swimming over, following the shrimp that shows half its body."

paras.zh: 一个朋友请我和丈夫去他家做客，我们很高兴地拿着礼物去了。刚进门，主人就为我们准备了一次性拖鞋，这种拖鞋真不舒服。
paras.py: Yí gè péngyou qǐng wǒ hé zhàngfu qù tā jiā zuòkè, wǒmen hěn gāoxìng de názhe lǐwù qù le. Gāng jìn mén, zhǔrén jiù wèi wǒmen zhǔnbèile yícìxìng tuōxié, zhè zhǒng tuōxié zhēn bù shūfu.
paras.en: A friend invited my husband and me to visit his home, and we happily went with gifts. As soon as we came in, the host gave us disposable slippers. These slippers were really uncomfortable.

paras.zh: 主人很热情地请我们坐下，给我们端茶。茶很热，可是主人让我们使用一次性纸杯。吃饭的时间到了，主人拿出一次性桌布铺在漂亮的桌子上，又拿出了一次性碗和一次性筷子。于是，我和丈夫很快地吃完饭，决定早点儿离开。
paras.py: Zhǔrén hěn rèqíng de qǐng wǒmen zuòxià, gěi wǒmen duān chá. Chá hěn rè, kěshì zhǔrén ràng wǒmen shǐyòng yícìxìng zhǐbēi. Chīfàn de shíjiān dào le, zhǔrén náchū yícìxìng zhuōbù pū zài piàoliang de zhuōzi shang, yòu náchūle yícìxìng wǎn hé yícìxìng kuàizi. Yúshì, wǒ hé zhàngfu hěn kuài de chīwán fàn, juédìng zǎo diǎnr líkāi.
paras.en: The host warmly asked us to sit down and served us tea. The tea was very hot, but he had us use disposable paper cups. When it was time to eat, he spread a disposable tablecloth on his beautiful table, then brought out disposable bowls and disposable chopsticks. So my husband and I finished eating quickly and decided to leave early.

paras.zh: 主人送我们下楼，顺便把我们用过的东西“哗”的一声扔到了垃圾箱里。然后，主人愉快地笑了起来，说道：“谢谢，谢谢，欢迎你们下次再来。”
paras.py: Zhǔrén sòng wǒmen xià lóu, shùnbiàn bǎ wǒmen yòngguo de dōngxi “huā” de yì shēng rēngdàole lājīxiāng li. Ránhòu, zhǔrén yúkuài de xiàole qǐlái, shuōdào: “Xièxie, xièxie, huānyíng nǐmen xià cì zài lái.”
paras.en: The host walked us downstairs, and on the way he threw everything we had used into the trash bin with a "whoosh". Then he laughed happily and said, "Thank you, thank you! Please come again next time."

paras.zh: “哦，天哪，这样的做客‘一次性’就够了！”
paras.py: “Ò, tiān na, zhèyàng de zuòkè ‘yícìxìng’ jiù gòu le!”
paras.en: "Oh my goodness, one visit like this is enough!" (一次性 means both "disposable" and "just once".)
